codePolicy: English code blocks and all inline code spans preserve the source. Chinese code blocks translate reviewed natural-language comments only; executable text, identifiers, strings, URLs, directives and commented-out code are preserved.
reviewPolicy: AI sentence-level semantic review, verified exact-text reuse, and immutable identifier verification are recorded separately. Code comments have their own translation/review register. Risk-based independent AI cross-review is not a claim of human expert certification.
